Locked away in the pocket between this world and the Outworld, victims realize their infantile knowledge and mortality.
Imprisoned units can still be hit by Sanity's Eclipse.
Max mana steal does not increase Outworld Destroyer's current mana values or directly reduce the victim's mana values.

tokens.npc_dota_hero_obsidian_destroyer_bio: One of a lordly and magisterial race, Harbinger prowls the edge of the Void, sole surviving sentry of an outpost on the world at the rim of the abyss. From this jagged crystalline Outworld, forever on guard, he has gazed for eternities into the heavens, alert for any stirring in the bottomless night beyond the stars. Imprinted deep in the shining lattices of his intellect lies a resonant pattern akin to prophecy, a dark music implying that eventually some evil will wake out there, beyond the edges of creation, and turn its attention to our world. With his whole being focused on his vigil, Outworld Destroyer paid little attention to events closer in to the sun. But at last the clamor of the Ancients, and a sense of growing threat from within as well as without, sent him winging sunward to visit the plains of war. Harbinger's place in our own prophecies is unambiguous: he must be considered an omen of worse things to come. But his arrival in itself is bad enough.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_obsidian_destroyer_hype: Stealing from the minds of those he imprisons, Outworld Destroyer turns raw intelligence into destructive power. Weakening enemies with a barrage of arcane energy, he shatters their sanity with his ultimate blast, often erasing mana from those that survive.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* Essence Flux uses {{M|pseudo-random distribution}} {{Proc|{{#var:Essence Flux value1}}}}.

* The ability has two main components:
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|1|21px]]
*** The passive proc ability effects are applied as follows:
***# The ability cast.
***# Procs the self-{{M|mana restore}} component, and is defined as:
***#* {{cf|expr}} {{Code|Max[[Mana|MP]] × ({{#var:Essence Flux value2}} + {{ValueColor||{{Show|T|Outworld Destroyer|v2r}}%|tal|x}} + ({{#var:Essence Flux basic1}} × [[wikipedia:Floor and ceiling functions|⌊]] SelfLvl / {{#var:Essence Flux type2 value1}} [[wikipedia:Floor and ceiling functions|⌋]]))}}
***#* Restores mana from all active abilities, except item ability casts, including from the following sources:
***#** Active {{M|attack modifiers}}.
***#*** However, it has a lower {{M|mana restore}} value.
***#** Ability [[toggling]] {{Symbol|Toggle|On}} {{Symbol|Toggle|Off}}.
***#** {{M|Sub-ability}} casts.
***#** On abilities that usually do not proc {{M|on-cast effects}}.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|2|21px]]
*** {{cf|talnotes}} The {{ValueColor||movement speed bonus|15tal}} {{M|talent|t=t2l}} checks the Harbinger's {{M|current mana}} values per {{M|server tick}} and grants flat {{M|movement speed}} bonus accordingly.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_obsidian_destroyer
data.bio_loc: One of a lordly and magisterial race, Harbinger prowls the edge of the Void, sole surviving sentry of an outpost on the world at the rim of the abyss. From this jagged crystalline Outworld, forever on guard, he has gazed for eternities into the heavens, alert for any stirring in the bottomless night beyond the stars. Imprinted deep in the shining lattices of his intellect lies a resonant pattern akin to prophecy, a dark music implying that eventually some evil will wake out there, beyond the edges of creation, and turn its attention to our world. With his whole being focused on his vigil, Outworld Destroyer paid little attention to events closer in to the sun. But at last the clamor of the Ancients, and a sense of growing threat from within as well as without, sent him winging sunward to visit the plains of war. Harbinger's place in our own prophecies is unambiguous: he must be considered an omen of worse things to come. But his arrival in itself is bad enough.
data.hype_loc: Stealing from the minds of those he imprisons, Outworld Destroyer turns raw intelligence into destructive power. Weakening enemies with a barrage of arcane energy, he shatters their sanity with his ultimate blast, often erasing mana from those that survive.
data.npe_desc_loc: Can imprison a hero, making them invulnerable

abilities.name: obsidian_destroyer_arcane_orb
abilities.desc_loc: Adds extra pure damage to Outworld Destroyer's attacks, based on his remaining mana pool.
abilities.lore_loc: Harbinger's outworldly knowledge allows it to tap into the ebb and flow of all spiritual energy, infusing it into his being.
notes_loc: The damage is calculated after the mana cost is spent.
abilities.scepter_loc: Arcane Orb bounces to an additional target for %bounce_damage_reduction%%% less damage.

abilities.name: obsidian_destroyer_astral_imprisonment
abilities.desc_loc: Steals a percentage of the target's max mana and places them into an astral prison. The hidden unit is invulnerable and disabled. When the astral prison implodes, it deals damage to the target.
abilities.lore_loc: Locked away in the pocket between this world and the Outworld, victims realize their infantile knowledge and mortality.
notes_loc: Imprisoned units can still be hit by Sanity's Eclipse.
Max mana steal does not increase Outworld Destroyer's current mana values or directly reduce the victim's mana values.
abilities.shard_loc: Astral Imprisonment now deals damage in an area. Also allows allies to move at %allied_movement_speed_pct%%% movement speed during Astral Imprisonment (they are visible, but untargettable and can't perform any other actions).
facets_loc: Affected Heroes gain a Mana Allergy Debuff for %debuff_duration% seconds, healing Outworld Destroyer every time they cast a spell.

abilities.name: obsidian_destroyer_objurgation
abilities.desc_loc: Increases Outworld Destroyer's maximum mana. When cast, protects Outworld Destroyer with an all damage barrier equal to a flat amount and a percentage of his maximum mana.
abilities.scepter_loc: Increases max mana to barrier. Damage that would bring Outworld Destroyer below %automatic_trigger_threshold%%% health is prevented. When that happens, Outworld Destroyer receives a strong dispel and gains an undispellable instance of Objurgation. This effect cannot occur more than once every %automatic_trigger_cd% seconds.

abilities.name: obsidian_destroyer_equilibrium
abilities.desc_loc: Passively grants a chance to restore a percentage of your max mana each time you cast an ability. Restores less mana from spells that modify attacks.
abilities.lore_loc: The Outworld is awash in arcane energy, inclined to diffuse through any of Harbinger's rifts.
facets_loc: When Essence Flux restores mana, it also temporarily increases maximum mana.

abilities.name: obsidian_destroyer_sanity_eclipse
abilities.desc_loc: Unleashes a psychic blast that deals damage to enemies based on the difference between your max mana and the target's max mana. Sanity's Eclipse can hit units trapped by Astral Imprisonment.
abilities.lore_loc: When an Outworld crystal ruptures, cataclysmic energies are released, and the reverberations of this power are felt interdimensionally.
facets_loc: Affected Heroes gain a Mana Allergy Debuff for %debuff_duration% seconds, healing Outworld Destroyer every time they cast a spell.
